tasks.title: Create Backup Strategy and Branches
tasks.description: Implement the backup strategy by creating specified git branches and committing the current state before any video removal work begins.
tasks.details:
Execute the following git commands:
1. `git checkout -b backup/video-features`
2. `git add .`
3. `git commit -m "Backup before video removal"`
4. `git checkout -b refactor/remove-video`
Ensure you are on the `refactor/remove-video` branch before starting modifications.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the `backup/video-features` branch exists and contains a commit with the message "Backup before video removal". Confirm that the `refactor/remove-video` branch is created and is the current working branch.

tasks.title: Backup Critical Files
tasks.description: Manually or via script, create copies of critical application files and store them in a secure location outside the project repository.
tasks.details:
Backup the following files:
- `/shira_app/app/(tabs)/learn.tsx`
- `/shira_app/app/learn-components/learnReducer.ts`
- `/shira_app/app/learn-components/types.ts`
- `/shira_app/supabase/contentService.ts`
- `/shira_app/supabase/types.ts`
Store these copies in a designated backup folder.
tasks.testStrategy: Confirm that all listed files have been copied to the backup location and that their contents are identical to the originals at the time of backup.

tasks.title: Establish and Execute Baseline Functionality Testing
tasks.description: Perform thorough testing of all non-video features to establish a functional baseline. Document all test results.
tasks.details:
Test the following features comprehensively:
- Context Quiz: Navigate to learn tab, verify quiz loads, test answer submission.
- Cultural View: Verify content loads and box animations work.
- Conversational Practice: Test conversation flow and translations.
- Progress Tracking: Verify streak counter and daily goals.
- Navigation: Test tab switching and sidebar navigation.
- Audio Features: Verify expo-av audio functionality still works.
tasks.testStrategy: All baseline features must pass testing. Document results for each feature, noting any existing bugs or issues to differentiate from new ones introduced during refactoring.

tasks.title: Remove Video Dependencies from package.json
tasks.description: Uninstall and remove `react-native-youtube-iframe` and `react-native-video` dependencies from the project's `package.json`.
tasks.details:
1. Run `npm uninstall react-native-youtube-iframe react-native-video` or `yarn remove react-native-youtube-iframe react-native-video`.
2. Verify that `react-native-youtube-iframe` and `react-native-video` are removed from the `dependencies` section of `package.json`.
3. Verify changes in `package-lock.json` or `yarn.lock`.
4. Ensure `expo-av` dependency is preserved as it's needed for audio.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify the app builds and runs successfully on target platforms (iOS/Android) after removing dependencies and reinstalling node_modules (e.g., by deleting `node_modules` and running `npm install`). Confirm audio functionality using `expo-av` is still working.

tasks.title: Plan Database Migration for Video Data Removal
tasks.description: Design and write a SQL migration script to remove video-specific JSONB fields/keys from the content table in the Supabase database.
tasks.details:
Create a SQL migration script. This script will target the table storing lesson content (e.g., `lessons` or `content`).
If the video data is stored within a JSONB column (e.g., `attributes`) as a nested object (e.g., `video: {id: ..., length: ...}`), the script should remove the entire 'video' key:
`-- Example: UPDATE your_content_table SET your_jsonb_column = your_jsonb_column - 'video';`
This will remove `video.id`, `video.length`, `video.clipStart`, `video.clipEnd`, `video.highlightPhrase`, and `video.captions` by removing their parent 'video' object. Document the exact table and column names used in the script. Ensure a database backup plan is in place before execution.
tasks.testStrategy: Review the SQL script for correctness and to ensure it only targets video-specific data. Test the script on a non-production database instance if possible. Confirm that the script is idempotent or clearly documented if not.

tasks.title: Execute Database Migration and Verify
tasks.description: Backup the database, then execute the prepared database migration script. Verify data integrity post-migration.
tasks.details:
1. Perform a full backup of the production database before running any migration scripts.
2. Execute the SQL migration script (developed in Task 14) on a staging environment first, then on the production database.
3. After execution, query the database to confirm that video-specific fields/keys are removed from the content table.
4. Verify that non-video data remains intact and has not been unintentionally altered.
tasks.testStrategy: Confirm successful script execution. Query the database schema and sample records to ensure video data is gone. Test application functionality that reads from the modified table(s) to ensure content loads correctly and data integrity is maintained for non-video content.

tasks.title: Learn Screen Layout Updates
tasks.description: Adjust the Learn screen UI in `/shira_app/app/(tabs)/learn.tsx` to remove the space previously occupied by the video player and optimize the layout for remaining components like the context quiz.
tasks.details:
Modify the JSX and styles in `/shira_app/app/(tabs)/learn.tsx` and related stylesheet files:
- Remove the container or layout elements that previously held the video player.
- Expand the context quiz component or other relevant components to utilize the newly available screen real estate.
- Adjust margins, padding, and component spacing to ensure a balanced, clean, and visually appealing layout.
- Ensure the layout remains responsive across different screen sizes and orientations.
tasks.testStrategy: Visually inspect the Learn screen on various device emulators/physical devices. Ensure the UI looks polished, with no awkward empty spaces or misaligned elements. Confirm the context quiz and other components are well-positioned and usable. Test responsiveness.

tasks.title: Navigation Updates (Tab Bar and Sidebar)
tasks.description: Update the application's tab bar and sidebar menu items to remove any links or references to video features. Ensure navigation between remaining features is smooth.
tasks.details:
1. Identify the code responsible for defining the tab bar structure (likely in your React Navigation setup).
   - Remove any tabs that were dedicated to video content or features.
2. Identify the code for the sidebar menu.
   - Remove any menu items that linked to video-related sections.
3. Test all navigation paths to ensure they lead to the correct screens and that there are no dead links or errors.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the tab bar and sidebar accurately reflect the available, non-video features. Test navigation thoroughly by clicking all tabs and menu items. Ensure smooth transitions and correct screen loading.

tasks.title: Perform Full Regression and Final Integration Testing
tasks.description: Conduct comprehensive testing covering all aspects of the application, including all baseline features, user journeys, performance, cross-platform compatibility, audio, and progress tracking.
tasks.details:
Execute the full testing protocol as defined in the PRD:
- Re-run all baseline functionality tests.
- Perform complete user journey testing for all core paths.
- Validate application performance; check for improvements (e.g., app bundle size reduction) and ensure no degradation in remaining features.
- Test on target platforms (iOS/Android).
- Specifically verify audio functionality in conversational practice (`expo-av`).
- Confirm progress tracking accuracy (streaks, daily goals).
- Check for any console errors or warnings.
- Review UI/UX for polish and adherence to post-video design adjustments.
tasks.testStrategy: All tests must pass. Document all findings. Verify that all success criteria from the PRD's "Definition of Done" and "Success Metrics" sections are met. Specifically confirm reduction in app bundle size.
